sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Institutional Hierarchy**: The AICC acts as the **legislative wing** of the Congress, while the **Congress Working Committee (CWC)** acts as the executive/cabinet.
• **Decision-Making Mechanism**: AICC meetings are convened to ratify major resolutions passed by the CWC, providing democratic legitimacy to radical shifts in policy.
• **Historical Significance**: The **August 1942 Bombay Session** of the AICC is the most critical, where the 'Quit India' resolution was formally ratified.
• **Key Metric**: The AICC consists of members elected by the **Provincial Congress Committees (PCCs)**, ensuring a federal structure within the party.

sections.title: Comprehensive Classification & Comparative Matrix
rows: Held once a year; sets broad ideological goals.
Prelims: Focus on President, location, and unique resolutions.
Mains: Focus on policy shifts (e.g., 1942 Quit India).

items.definition: The 'High Command' of the Congress, responsible for day-to-day operations and drafting resolutions for the AICC.
Passed at the Gowalia Tank Maidan, Bombay, during the AICC meeting; marked the shift to 'Do or Die'.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Policy Ratification**: AICC meetings served as the platform to convert CWC proposals into national mandates.
• **Mass Mobilization**: Used as a tool to signal the start of nationwide civil disobedience campaigns.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Internal Dissent**: Balancing radical (Subhash Bose/Socialists) and moderate factions.
• **State Repression**: British colonial authorities often banned AICC meetings to decapitate the leadership.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'G-A-R' (Gowalia, August, Resolution).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Gowalia Tank (Location), August 1942 (Date), Resolution (Quit India).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the 'Annual Session' with 'AICC Meetings'. Remember: AICC meetings are the 'working' sessions, not necessarily the annual plenary.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Democratic Centralism' to describe the relationship between the CWC and AICC in your answers.

keyTakeaways: AICC is the legislative body of the INC, distinct from the annual plenary sessions.
The 1942 AICC meeting at Bombay is the most significant for UPSC due to the Quit India Movement.
The CWC-AICC relationship represents the internal power dynamics of the Indian freedom struggle.
